description: Everything the FactLot Registry knows about a parcel, legal entity, or building: status, current cited facts (owner of record, situs address, property category, areas, values), ownership links, external IDs, and for a parcel the building it belongs to (condominium units roll up into one building). value_history (parcels) lists market and appraised value by tax year from every snapshot, newest first, each value cited; a tax year two snapshots value differently appears once per value. as_of gives the facts as they stood on a date. warnings flags area facts that look wrong (building area above 40 times the land area, a land area of 0); the facts themselves are as the source publishes them. A building record can carry debt.cmbs_loan facts (one per CMBS trust holding a note of its loan: balance, rate, maturity, payment status, servicer, special-servicing dates, NOI, DSCR) and an entity record can carry entity.parent facts (the SEC registrant that lists it as a subsidiary in Exhibit 21), each cited to its SEC filing. A miss says whether the county or entity registry is loaded. Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD): return the facts and ownership links current on that date, from the snapshots dated on or before it, instead of the latest. With include_history, history stops at that date.

include_history.description: Also return every fact from every snapshot, superseded ones included (history lists current facts too; a source loaded once has no superseded facts).

urn.description: FactLot URN of a parcel, entity, or building, e.g. fl:parcel:us-48201:0011440000001.

name: registry_get
title: Get a registry record
